issues.where: crop 4 and crop 5, the leaves facing the sun and the leaf blades nearest the stem
issues.what: with the sun behind and above the plant the leaf blades stay a dark opaque grey-green; no light passes through the thin blade, the veins do not glow or darken against the light, and the blades read as solid cards with a texture painted on
issues.fix: add subsurface or translucency to the leaf material so backlit blades glow warm green, with the vein network showing darker against the light

issues.where: crop 1 and crop 3, the bracts of the bud
issues.what: the bracts are near copies of one another in shape, curl and spacing and are arranged almost symmetrically, all in one flat slightly waxy green with even specular; at native size it looks like a procedural instanced model
issues.fix: vary each bract's length, width, twist and tip curl, break the symmetry, and add colour variation (yellower bases, darker tips) and a rougher, less glossy surface

issues.where: crop 3 and crop 5, the leaf margins and bract edges
issues.what: the frost is only a thin, even white rim that follows every edge at the same width, like an outline or fresnel pass; the leaf faces and stem carry almost no frost crystals, so the frost does not read as real rime
issues.fix: build frost as crystals that grow unevenly, thicker on exposed edges and upper faces and thinner in sheltered parts, with scattered crystals across the blade and on the hairs

issues.where: crop 5, the pale petiole curving from the stem to the lower right leaf
issues.what: the petiole is a smooth, evenly lit tube with no hairs or frost, paler and more plastic than the hairy main stem next to it
issues.fix: give the petioles the same hairy, frosted, matte material as the stem

issues.where: crop 8, the far flower heads at the skyline
issues.what: several distant heads have very similar silhouettes and stem heights, which hints at instanced copies
issues.fix: vary the head size, tilt and stem height of the background plants

issues.where: crop 4, the leaf margins against the bright fog
issues.what: the hairs on the margin form an even, regular fringe of the same length all round, slightly halo-like against the fog
issues.fix: randomise hair length and density along the margin and soften the bright rim
